note: Play the story first, in chapter order, and start the missable trophy in Chapter 1. The long tail — counts, collectibles and stranger strands — comes after the credits, when the whole map is open.

oneTimeMoments.detail: The only confirmed permanently missable trophy. Meditate at Jason's house in Chapter 1; after the chapter closes, that spot is gone for good.
oneTimeMoments.title: First meditation — Jason's house

oneTimeMoments.detail: The first mission sets the tone. Nothing here is missable, but it is the only time the trip plays out this way.
oneTimeMoments.title: Gone Fishing — the opening boat trip

oneTimeMoments.detail: A supply run that doubles as a trust exercise. Do it when it appears; it will not wait for you.
oneTimeMoments.title: Breakfast Run — the trust run

oneTimeMoments.detail: The first big heist. Plan it, hit it, get out clean — the approach you pick is yours alone.
oneTimeMoments.title: The Cartel Heist — first big score

oneTimeMoments.detail: A family mission on Lucia's side. Play it when it appears on the map.
oneTimeMoments.title: Child's Play — Lucia's call

oneTimeMoments.detail: The crew's name goes up, and the fall follows. A one-time story beat.
oneTimeMoments.title: Headliners — the name in lights

oneTimeMoments.detail: The crew hits Vice City International Airport. Do the takedown when it opens.
oneTimeMoments.title: VCIA Takedown — the airport job

oneTimeMoments.detail: The biggest set piece before the finale. Complete the operation when it appears.
oneTimeMoments.title: Operation Savage Glory — the military op

oneTimeMoments.detail: The last mission. Finish it and the credits roll — the gold pops at the end.
oneTimeMoments.title: The final mission

oneTimeMoments.detail: Three shops back-to-back with your partner, one wanted level. Line the shops up before you start.
oneTimeMoments.title: First partner robbery — Retail Therapy
oneTimeMoments.when: Chapter 4, free roam with your partner

oneTimeMoments.detail: A cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A quiet moment worth taking before the endgame rush.
oneTimeMoments.title: Ocean Beach cocktail at sunset
oneTimeMoments.when: Any time, but do it early

oneTimeMoments.detail: Bowl a full game at the Kolt & Associates alley. Follow through on every frame.
oneTimeMoments.title: First frame at Kolt & Associates

stages.blurb: Learn Leonida, start the missable trophy on day one, and sample the side life while the story is still small.
stages.name: Landfall

stages.blurb: The city opens up. First heist, first races, and the crew's name in lights.
stages.name: Vice City

stages.blurb: The climb, the airport job, the military operation, and the final mission. Grind stunts and the range on the side.
stages.name: Top of the World

stages.blurb: The whole map is open. Finish the stranger strands, hunt the collectibles, and grind the counts.
stages.name: The long tail

stages.blurb: Clear the last 100% checklist boxes, and the platinum lands on its own.
stages.name: Leonida Legend
